blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The impression of former Sen. Antonio Trillanes IV that he is “not welcome” in the impeachment court is a “baseless assumption,” Senate impeachment court spokesperson Atty. Reginald Tongol said on Friday. Trillanes, in a press conference, said that it is “clear” that he is “not welcome” at the Senate impeachment court after he was not issued a subpoena to testify on Vice President Sara Duterte’s alleged unexplained wealth. “Our impeachment court and senator-judges did not have that kind of impression on former Sen. Trillanes…,” Tongol clarified. “The impeachment court did not show him anything like that. So, I […]...
